about: Shared table for the sentence a Series' Rights say about use in training machine-learning models (ADR 0041). Run by pytest (tests/v2/test_rights.py, atlas.rights.ml_use_note) and Vitest (packages/core/src/rights.test.ts, mlUseNote) so the two bodies cannot drift. `rights` is a Catalog entry's Rights block, or the part of it the sentence reads; `note` is the sentence, or null when nothing is said.

cases.name: one signed row reserves it

cases.name: three reserve it
cases.note: Not for use in training machine-learning models: A's, B's and C's terms reserve it

cases.name: a name that ends in s
cases.note: Not for use in training machine-learning models: Bureau of Statistics' terms reserve it
